Linking to files outside the vault is mentioned in the manual, under drag and drop, but only in passing and without a single example of what the link should look like.

Hold the modifier key while dropping a file to create a link to its location instead of copying it into the vault, which keeps large media out of your synchronised folders.

That is all it says, so I will write up the variants that work on each system below, and ask for the examples to be added to the official page as well.

On a network share the path needs four slashes after the scheme, not three.

I lost an afternoon to that. The app gives no error, the link simply does nothing when you click it.

Spaces are the other trap: wrap the whole address in angle brackets, or replace every space with its percent code, and do not mix the two styles inside one note.
